lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for one home wait_info test where the prediction was too low.
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin because almost all categories have only a single test.
Sign-in reorder changes (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (3 tests) show mixed results: one test won (+3.5% after noise correction), while two showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign won (+5.3% after noise correction), but evidence is still thin with only one test.
Finish new_screen (-5.5% after noise correction) and adoption hint (-3.2%) degraded performance, but evidence remains thin for both categories.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Quick Reference Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro step into a two-column desktop interaction showcase explaining drag, right-click, and speech controls before finishing.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup, while finish conversion is 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is active on your desktop! Click and drag to reposition, or right-click to open interaction controls.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay to explain controls is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off and support email evidence, but major redesign carries implementation complexity.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Card Refresh
candidates.change: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a clear grid layout to highlight summary details before finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.2% with a high median duration of 89s; adoption redesigns previously generated a positive conversion lift.

adoption_certificate.headline: Finalize Your Companion Adoption
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion details and complete the official adoption record.

guard.reason: Updating the adoption certificate layout to grid retains the core adoption functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targeting step with 33.8% drop-off; adoption layout changes previously showed positive results.

candidates.title: Account Sync & Multi-Device Warning Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining account synchronization and preventing lost pets on re-login.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or resetting after signing in again on secondary sessions.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary email to instantly restore your desktop pets across all devices.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Desktop Launch & Generation Activity Feed
candidates.change: Display explicit generation stage details and time estimates on the waiting screen while the pet renders.
candidates.why: Home wait time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s), leading to user fatigue while awaiting desktop spawn.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Environment
waiting.body: Synthesizing pet animations and configuring desktop background integration.

guard.reason: Displaying time estimates and progress during a real wait screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait times on home step; historical wait_info tests yielded mild mixed positive results.

candidates.title: Path Selector Card Layout Overhaul
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen with card-style visual containers and asset previews.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% (76.2% conversion), with long mean duration (514s) indicating visual uncertainty.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to create or pick your desktop pet today.

guard.reason: Redesigning the path selection screen while keeping choices for both creating and adopting is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns visual flow for path selection; medium drop-off step with no explicit email backing.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction & Controls Onboarding Flow
candidates.change: Append an interactive controls sub-flow to teach fundamental desktop shortcuts right before finalizing setup.
candidates.why: Users wrote support tickets expressing confusion on controlling or hiding pets post-onboarding.

new_controls_flow.headline: Mastering Desktop Commands
new_controls_flow.body: Try right-clicking your pet, dragging it across screens, or toggling hide mode.

guard.reason: Adding a new interactive controls sub-flow after home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding extra steps/sub-flows at the finish step historically degraded conversion due to added friction.

candidates.title: Pre-Generation Photo Verification Screen
candidates.change: Insert a photo quality verification step right after photo upload to confirm clarity prior to adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results after submitting photos.

new_photo_check.headline: Verify Photo Quality
new_photo_check.body: Ensure your photo is clear and well-lit so your desktop pet generates perfectly.

guard.reason: Adding a photo verification step in the onboarding sequence retains all mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: Strong support signal, but introducing a new screen tends to lower funnel completion rates.

candidates.title: Compact Quick Sign-In Interface
candidates.change: Streamline the sign-in screen layout into a compact layout for rapid authentication.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users, and 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalling or failing to load.

sign_in.headline: Quick Sign-In
sign_in.body: Connect your account to save your pet progress seamlessly.

guard.reason: Streamlining the sign-in layout is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Streamlines 27.1% sign-in drop-off supported by failure reports; moderate expected improvement.

candidates.title: Companion Journey Value Proposition Copy
candidates.change: Revise story screen text to clearly communicate what desktop pets do right from the initial screen.
candidates.why: Mean duration on choose_path reaches 514s, showing hesitation due to unclear onboarding expectations.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring an interactive, personalized pet to life on your desktop screen in just a few quick steps.

guard.reason: Updating story copy to introduce the pet is valid.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak addressing initial hesitation and high step duration.

candidates.title: Background Generation Completion Alert
candidates.change: Enable optional background notifications on the waiting screen so users get notified when generation completes.
candidates.why: Mean home waiting time is 2336s, causing users to switch windows and forget to return to complete onboarding.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding optional background notifications during the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Solves window switching during 2336s average wait duration with background alerts.
